## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +0.69% | 1M: -2.17%) RECOVERY shows muted fear, while credit stress is rising via HYG (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.73%) & LQD (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND; SPY/TLT ↑ rising (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +5.27%) ABOVE TREND adds a mixed datapoint.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.73%) & LQD (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND. Fear mostly complacent but edging: VXX (1W: +0.69% | 1M: -2.17%) RECOVERY; Stocks vs Bonds strength: SPY/TLT ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength holding: UUP proxy (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND. Yield sensitivity rising: TLT (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND and Duration Preference ↓ falling, signaling tighter financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
No sector leadership — breadth 0/11. Tech showing relative resilience: XLK (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) ABOVE TREND while Financials lag: XLF (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND; style mixed with Growth pockets outperforming but not broad.

5. US vs Global?
US tepid: SPY (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -0.33%) BELOW TREND; QQQ (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +3.32%) CORRECTION shows Nasdaq leadership in the month. EM/China remain weak: EEM (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed/speculative pockets: IBIT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.98%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.13%) CORRECTION show month-to-date risk-on flows but 1W softness; IWM (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND signals small-cap caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodities mixed with divergence: BNO (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +13.72%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +8.95%) CORRECTION show month strength, while CPER (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -0.55%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND show commodity dispersion.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy overall soft: XLE (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -3.27%) BELOW TREND; NatGas weak: UNG (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, while Brent BNO (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +13.72%) CORRECTION remains the notable exception.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Mixed confirmations — Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY/TLT) and VXX RECOVERY point to contained risk, but credit (HYG/LQD) and sector breadth (0/11) contradict; MINOR divergence across commodities/thematics (BNO, USO, IBIT, ARKK, QQQ) — note but don't overweight.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective: favor XLK (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND where momentum exists, and reduce exposure to XLF (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND and XLB (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND given weak breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology / Semis — XLK (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND if momentum continues. BEARISH: Financials & Materials — XLF (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, XLB (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent/energy continuation — BNO (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +13.72%) CORRECTION. BEARISH: Precious metals and base metals — SLV (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -9.35%) BELOW TREND, CPER (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -0.55%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF ratio ~3.7 (growth vs value tilt); SPY support rounds near recent 1M performance pause.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and semiconductors showing relative strength: XLK (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk is rising credit stress versus muted volatility and pronounced sector narrowness — monitor HYG (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.73%) BELOW TREND and breadth deterioration.
